This document details a series of urgent tasks related to the review and optimization of key HR policies and employee welfare programs:

*   Investigate career development programs urgently.
*   Update career development programs based on audit recommendations.
*   Optimize the bonus structure standard update.
*   Monitor medical insurance policies based on audit findings.
*   Monitor the bonus structure based on audit findings.
